# Specification: tag filter on the task list

## Summary

The task list gains a tag filter and a CSV export. The specification carries 11 requirements and no breaking change.

## User stories

### user-story-filter-by-tag

A member opens the task list, picks a tag and sees only the tasks carrying it. Confirmed by the person.

### user-story-export-csv

A member exports the filtered list as CSV. Drafted, not confirmed.
